request.deadline: 2026 funding period; 12 months of funding stated, but exact start and end dates not stated in document
deliverables: 12 months of Ledger and Trezor compatibility updates
maintenance of supporting interoperability libraries and cardano-hw-cli
support for integration paths involving externally maintained components where shared hardware-wallet flows intersect
vendor-required product or security audits where firmware or app changes trigger them
transparent capped time-and-materials reporting and milestone-based disbursement controls
request.recipient: Intersect 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal for Hardware Wallet Maintenance 2026 covering production maintenance of Cardano hardware-wallet support.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,310,960 ada, consisting of 1,272,777 ada for Cardano Hardware Wallet Maintenance and Compatibility Assurance and 38,183 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The work scope is limited to compatibility, security, supporting libraries and tooling, release support, and vendor-required audit work for supported hardware-wallet flows.

The proposer says continuous hardware-wallet maintenance is needed because Cardano protocol evolution, vendor firmware and app release cycles, and wallet and dApp integration demand create compatibility risk.
The proposer says funding continuity in 2026 is less costly and less disruptive than waiting for breakage to accumulate and reacting after users or integrators lose access.
The proposal claims it does not duplicate broader core-node, ledger, or general infrastructure maintenance budgets.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer claims the requested amount did not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Intersect will use a Sundae Labs treasury management smart contract framework with one Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract for administration and disbursement.

The document states oversight will involve Intersect admin and leadership roles plus an Oversight Committee of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl with specified multisignature authorization thresholds.
A dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi is provided for community audit and tracking of the withdrawn ada and related smart contract metrics.

summary: The document presents a 1,310,960 ada continuity funding request for 12 months of Cardano hardware-wallet compatibility and maintenance work, with Intersect-administered smart contract custody, external oversight, prior funding disclosures, and several external references for voting, audits, contracts, and dashboards.
